crossRefs.note: Because by the works of the law, no flesh will be justified in his sight; for through the law comes the knowledge of…
Where then is the boasting? It is excluded. By what kind of law? Of works? No, but by a law of faith.
We maintain therefore that a man is justified by faith apart from the works of the law.
For if Abraham was justified by works, he has something to boast about, but not toward God.
For being not yet born, neither having done anything good or bad, that the purpose of God according to election might…
So then it is not of him who wills, nor of him who runs, but of God who has mercy.
And if by grace, then it is no longer of works; otherwise grace is no longer grace. But if it is of works, it is no…
that no flesh should boast before God.
who saved us and called us with a holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace…
For we were also once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy…

translations.web: not of works, that no one would boast.
translations.bsb: not by works, so that no one can boast.
translations.kjv: Not of works, lest any man should boast.
translations.asv: not of works, that no man should glory.
